sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 76 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

supersedes.reason: The original inner border spikes across continuous pavement at vertex 184, nearly closing the road corridor. The native NAIP image, full automatic candidate overlay and original defect crop were reviewed. The replacement follows the retained source route on visible pavement. Edges remain automatic image-derived estimates, with unresolved pixel, shadow, shoulder and access-opening interpretation uncertainty; they are not surveyed barriers or complete manual measurements.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been formally verified; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.
